description: FreeToken brings datacenter-scale model serving to your desktop. Run massive models locally, fast and efficiently.

highlights: Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) first. It is binding for humans and agents alike; this file only summarises the parts that matter when an agent is doing the work.

AI-assisted code is welcome. Submitting code the contributor does not understand is not. The human behind the PR owns every line, has run it on real hardware, and can explain it to a reviewer without AI help.
assessment: Standard operational configuration for agentic pair programming.
